nodes.name: Manual Trigger
nodes.notes: Use this to run and test manually. Once verified, enable the Monthly Schedule node and disable this one.

nodes.name: Monthly Schedule
nodes.notes: Runs 1st of each month at 3:00am. Enable after successful manual test run.

nodes.name: List Reviews > 3yr
nodes.notes: Base: appLoQNoAydB65Vop (RSG Product Testing). Table: tblwEW5UcK5zbAvYi (Shoe Reviews). Only fetches F_Shoe_Reviewed formula field — attachment fields deliberately excluded to keep response small.

nodes.name: Build Dropbox URLs
nodes.notes: For each record: builds clickable Dropbox URL and plain path string. Stores count in static data for summary email.

nodes.name: Split in Batches
nodes.notes: Airtable PATCH API limit is 10 records per request. Output 0 = loop (current batch). Output 1 = done (all batches complete).

nodes.name: Format PATCH Body
nodes.notes: Produces { records: [...] } ready for Airtable PATCH. Clears Images + Edited Images. Sets Dropbox web URL (fldtW8hIvQiy1rx0G) and plain path (fldQ0clyA6yw4rLoy).

nodes.name: PATCH Airtable
nodes.notes: PATCHes up to 10 records. Uses same Airtable PAT as List node. neverError=true so a single failed batch doesn’t abort the whole run. Output loops back to Split in Batches.

nodes.name: Build Email
nodes.notes: Reads total record count from workflow static data (set earlier in Build Dropbox URLs node).
